parameters.name: DestinationRegionIds
parameters.description: The list of destination edge zone IDs.

parameters.name: DestinationSnapshotDescription
parameters.description: The description of the snapshot. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: DestinationSnapshotName
parameters.description: The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: InstanceBillingCycle
parameters.description:
The billing cycle of the instance. Valid values:

- Hour
- Day
- Month

parameters.name: SnapshotId
parameters.description: The ID of the source snapshot.
